title: FundPark Secures Up to US$250 Million from Bain Capital to Support Its Next Phase of Growth
summary: FundPark Secures Up to US$250 Million from Bain Capital to Support Its Next Phase of Growth
body_markdown:
*New financing commitment to strengthen FundPark’s institutional funding capacity and support greater access to growth capital for digital entrepreneurs and small businesses*


Hong Kong, 20 October 2026 – FundPark, a technology company pioneering Scale-Up as a Service to support the growth of digital entrepreneurs, today announced that Bain Capital, a leading global private investment firm, has agreed to provide up to US$250 million in financing to support FundPark’s continued growth. The financing comprises an initial US$100 million commitment and up to an additional US$150 million subject to certain conditions. The transaction will further strengthen FundPark's institutional funding capacity to support the continued growth of its technology-enabled platform for digital entrepreneurs.


The announcement comes as FundPark surpasses US$10 billion in cumulative financing lent to digital entrepreneurs. Through FundPark’s platform, businesses have collectively generated over US$18 billion in Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), reflecting the leverage created as institutional funding is deployed and the scale of commercial activity supported by FundPark's funding and technology ecosystem. Together, these milestones illustrate how technology and data can help amplify the impact of institutional capital in the real economy.
Hay Yip, Chief Strategy Officer and Chief of Staff at FundPark, said, “In financial services, scale is often measured by the amount of capital available. Yet the true value of that capital lies in the economic activity it enables for our customers.


Our US$10 billion milestone and the US$18 billion in merchant GMV generated by businesses on our platform demonstrate how institutional capital, when paired with technology and data, can create real economic impact beyond financing. As we enter our next decade, our focus is on increasing that multiplier effect and helping more entrepreneurs turn growth ambitions into commercial outcomes.”


**Supporting Cross-Border Digital Economy**


Bain Capital’s investment reflects its continued commitment to supporting the growth of innovative businesses in Hong Kong and the broader cross-border e-commerce ecosystem. The tailored financing solution will provide FundPark with flexible capital to facilitate its next phase of growth, while further strengthening the company’s institutional funding base. By supporting FundPark’s continued expansion, Bain Capital is helping broaden access to growth capital for digital businesses and entrepreneurs, enabling them to scale, capture new opportunities, and contribute to the continued growth of the digital economy.


“Hong Kong’s enduring strength has always been its talented entrepreneurs and the depth of its capital markets,” said Michael Hui, Partner at Bain Capital. “By backing local technology and fintech innovators like FundPark, we are bridging institutional capital with the agility of small and medium-sized e-commerce businesses, empowering them to scale up while reinforcing Hong Kong’s long-term role as the global financial and capital markets leader for the Greater Bay Area.”


“At Bain Capital, we seek to provide tailored and flexible capital solutions that meet the evolving needs of high-quality businesses and support their long-term growth,” said Andrew Schantz, Partner at Bain Capital. “Our investment in FundPark reflects this approach, providing the company with additional capital and financial flexibility to support its next phase of growth and extend its reach to more entrepreneurs and small businesses.”


**Measuring scale by impact**


Through its technology platform, FundPark connects institutional funding with digital entrepreneurs, helping businesses access financing based on real-time operational signals rather than traditional assessments alone. As capital is deployed into inventory, marketing, fulfilment and expansion, it supports tangible business growth and commercial activity across the broader digital economy. This relationship can be seen in FundPark's own growth trajectory.


Anson Suen, CEO and Co-founder of FundPark, said, “While we are proud of the milestones we have achieved, what matters most is the success of the entrepreneurs we have had the privilege to support along the way. Over the past decade, we have witnessed businesses grow from early ambitions into established brands, expand into new markets and create meaningful economic impact. As FundPark marks its 10th anniversary, it is a moment to reflect on the thousands of businesses that have trusted us to be part of their growth journey. Bain Capital's commitment is a strong endorsement of that shared journey and strengthens our ability to help the next generation of entrepreneurs realise their ambitions and scale with confidence.”


Founded in Hong Kong in 2016 to empower digital entrepreneurs, FundPark has evolved into a technology company operating at the intersection of AI, data, capital and commerce. Today, its Scale-Up-as-a-Service platform combines AI-enabled funding, predictive data insights and a community ecosystem to help entrepreneurs access not only capital, but also the insights and connections needed to scale.


As FundPark enters its second decade, the company remains guided by the same belief that inspired its founding: that entrepreneurs deserve not only access to capital, but also the tools, insights and community needed to realise their full growth potential.


###


**About FundPark**
FundPark is a technology company pioneering Scale-Up as a Service, a new blueprint that aims to rewrite the rules of scaling for digital entrepreneurs. Founded in Hong Kong, FundPark goes beyond traditional working capital lending, to integrate its AI-enabled dynamic funding, predictive insights and a community platform into a growth flywheel that helps eCommerce businesses move faster than the pace of demand.


Since 2020, FundPark has secured over US$1.25 billion in funding facilities backed by leading international financial institutions. The company has supported more than 40,000 online shops across Asia and beyond. As of October 2026, FundPark has facilitated over US$10 billion in financing to fuel the growth of small and medium-sized eCommerce entrepreneurs, enabling more than US$18 billion in cumulative merchant gross merchandise value (GMV). www.fundpark.com


**About Bain Capital**
Founded in 1984, Bain Capital is one of the world’s leading private investment firms. We create lasting impact for our investors, teams, businesses, and the communities in which we live. As a private partnership, we lead with conviction and a collaborative culture that enables us to innovate, unlock opportunity, and deliver strong outcomes. Our global platform invests across Private Equity, Growth & Venture, Capital Solutions, Credit & Capital Markets, and Real Assets. Across these focus areas, we bring deep sector expertise and broad capabilities. We have 24 offices on four continents, more than 2,000 employees, and approximately $225 billion in assets under management.
To learn more, visit www.baincapital.com. Follow @BainCapital on LinkedIn and X.
